summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Sequans Communications S.A., a French foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release of its preliminary unaudited financial results for Q1 2026. The filing contains only standard earnings data (revenue, gross profit, operating loss, net loss, and per-ADS figures) with no transactional event, merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC merger, or forced management change. As a regular earnings update filed under Rule 13a-16, it does not constitute a special situation.
